## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? -->

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `ci` / `build`: CI or packaging
- [ ] `docs`: documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `mypy` passes
- [ ] `pytest --cov` passes and coverage stays ≥ 85 %
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests that use **synthetic** data only
- [ ] Evidence is never opened in write mode; no network calls added
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] No real images, personal data, secrets or model weights are committed
